sonnet.problem: The blank asks the baker to supply the exact word 'defeated' from verse 7. No earlier card sets up what Paul means, so the baker can only guess the wording or rule out the plainly positive options by tone. It tests wording the baker hasn't seen, not meaning they can reason out.
sonnet.rule: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
